hints.title: Adjacent Step Graph Construction
hints.text: An edge connects index i and index i - 1 if their absolute numeric difference is within the allowed threshold.

hints.title: Disjoint Sets for Connectivity
hints.text: Merge adjacent indices satisfying the difference bound into shared connected components.

hints.title: Root Equality Validation
hints.text: Two query nodes can reach each other if and only if they belong to the same component root.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Disjoint set union connects adjacent indices in near-linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running breadth-first search from scratch per query takes O(Q * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Component parent array answers each query in nearly constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model the adjacency constraints as connected components using disjoint sets.
